BranchHierarchyResponse.title: BranchHierarchyResponse
BranchHierarchyResponse.description:
Tenant-wide branch tree (BFS-PF-005 §10 ``GET /org/branches/hierarchy``).

A forest is returned because branches without a parent are valid roots
(a tenant is not required to have a single top branch).

BranchReplace.title: BranchReplace
BranchReplace.description:
PUT payload — full replace (BFS-PF-005 §10 "Full update").

Mirrors PF-004's PUT rule: ``name`` is mandatory; ``code`` is immutable.

BusinessUnitReplace.title: BusinessUnitReplace
BusinessUnitReplace.description:
PUT payload — full replace (ELU-BFS-PF-007 §10 "Full update").

Mirrors the PF-004/PF-005/PF-006 PUT rule: ``name`` is mandatory; ``code`` is
immutable.

BusinessUnitUpdate.title: BusinessUnitUpdate
BusinessUnitUpdate.description:
PATCH payload — partial update (ELU-BFS-PF-007 §10).

``code`` is deliberately absent: the business-unit code is immutable (PF-004/PF-005/
PF-006 convention). ``organization_id`` is accepted only so that a change can be
explicitly rejected (D7 — immutable after creation).

CustomerSuspendRequest.title: CustomerSuspendRequest
CustomerSuspendRequest.description:
REQ-CRM-028 / BR-CRM-055: suspension requires a reason code and a comment.

Both are mandatory and must contain non-whitespace content; ``min_length=1`` alone
would accept a blank string, so the validators strip first and then reject.

DepartmentHierarchyResponse.title: DepartmentHierarchyResponse
DepartmentHierarchyResponse.description:
Tenant-wide department tree (ELU-BFS-PF-006 §10 ``GET /org/departments/hierarchy``).

A forest is returned because departments without a parent are valid roots. Depth
(``BR-PF-041``) is a service-layer rule and is not encoded in the schema.

DepartmentHistoryItem.title: DepartmentHistoryItem
DepartmentHistoryItem.description: Audit-trail row (ELU-BFS-PF-006 §15) — same keys as the PF-004/PF-005 item.

DepartmentMove.title: DepartmentMove
DepartmentMove.description:
PATCH payload — reparent (ELU-BFS-PF-006 §10 ``PATCH /{id}/move``).

``parent_department_id = None`` detaches the department to root level. ``code`` is
immutable and is not accepted; ``organization_id`` is deliberately **not** part of
the move operation (an organization change is a separate, policy-guarded update).

DepartmentReplace.title: DepartmentReplace
DepartmentReplace.description:
PUT payload — full replace (ELU-BFS-PF-006 §10 "Full update").

Mirrors the PF-004/PF-005 PUT rule: ``name`` is mandatory; ``code`` is immutable.

DepartmentUpdate.title: DepartmentUpdate
DepartmentUpdate.description:
PATCH payload — partial update (ELU-BFS-PF-006 §10).

``code`` is deliberately absent: the department code is immutable (PF-004/PF-005
convention). ``department_head_user_id`` is not accepted — it is read-only (PF-008).

NotificationPreferenceUpdate.title: NotificationPreferenceUpdate
NotificationPreferenceUpdate.description: One row per (event_type, module_code) — channel flags are columns (BFS §9).

PasswordActionResponse.title: PasswordActionResponse
PasswordActionResponse.description:
Result of an issued password challenge.

``reset_token`` is populated **only** for the permission-gated
``POST /users/{id}/reset-password`` path (`user.reset_password`), because the
``NTF-PF-008-03`` e-mail delivery is deferred (D11). The public
``POST /auth/forgot-password`` path never returns a token.

PlatformSettingUpsert.description: Bulk ``PUT /platform/settings`` item — carries the platform-global key.

RegisterRequest.title: RegisterRequest
RegisterRequest.description: POST /auth/register — activate an INVITED user with the 72-hour invitation token.

ResetPasswordRequest.title: ResetPasswordRequest
ResetPasswordRequest.description: POST /auth/reset-password — public, consumes a single-use reset token.

SettingCatalogueResponse.description: ``core.setting_catalogue`` — platform-global lookup for valid preference keys.

TenantSettingsUpdate.title: TenantSettingsUpdate
TenantSettingsUpdate.description: Partial update payload — only the released, editable tenant_settings columns.

UserCreateResponse.title: UserCreateResponse
UserCreateResponse.description: POST /users result; ``invite_token`` is returned **once** and never stored in clear.

UserInviteCreate.title: UserInviteCreate
UserInviteCreate.description:
POST /users — invite *or* create a user (ELU-BFS-PF-008 §10 "Invite/create user").

When ``password`` is supplied the account is created ``ACTIVE`` (admin-created account);
otherwise the account is created ``INVITED`` together with a 72-hour invitation
(`BR-PF-054`) and the invitation token is returned once.

UserPatch.title: UserPatch
UserPatch.description: PATCH /users/{id} — partial update incl. status transitions (`user.update`).

UserResponse.title: UserResponse
UserResponse.description: User profile projection (no credential material is ever exposed).

UserSelfUpdate.title: UserSelfUpdate
UserSelfUpdate.description: PUT /users/me — update own profile (no role / organization / status change).

UserUpdate.title: UserUpdate
UserUpdate.description:
PUT /users/{id} — full update (`user.update`).

``email`` is updatable subject to the per-tenant uniqueness of `BR-PF-051`;
``account_status`` is **not** accepted here (lifecycle changes go through PATCH, so the
state machine and the "last active Tenant Admin" guard of `BR-PF-060` stay in one place).
